mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.patient_id AS patientId, p.name AS patientName, r.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, r.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, r.registration_date AS registrationDate, r.time_slot AS timeSlot, r.queue_number AS queueNumber, r.status, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.create_time AS createTime FROM registration r LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = r.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = r.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = r.department_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.patient_id AS patientId, p.name AS patientName, r.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, r.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, r.registration_date AS registrationDate, r.time_slot AS timeSlot, r.queue_number AS queueNumber, r.status, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.create_time AS createTime FROM registration r LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = r.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = r.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = r.department_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND registration_date = #{date} AND status != 2
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 0 AND registration_date < #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.patient_id AS patientId, p.name AS patientName, r.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, r.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, r.registration_date AS registrationDate, r.time_slot AS timeSlot, r.queue_number AS queueNumber, r.status, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.create_time AS createTime FROM registration r LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = r.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = r.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = r.department_id WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.registration_date = CURDATE() AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.queue_number ASC
